On · tap to allow Wristline to start calls

Your watch gets a list of your contacts who can be called on WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal: only their names, never numbers or photos, and only on your own watch. Android will also ask to let Wristline \"make and manage phone calls\": WhatsApp, Telegram and Signal only start a call for apps that have it. Wristline never calls phone numbers itself. You also need Wristline on the watch: installing it takes a computer. Tap Help at the top of the home screen for the steps.

Follows your phone: calls it silences don\'t ring the watch
Ignored: calls ring the watch even in Do Not Disturb

When your phone is in Do Not Disturb (or Bedtime), Wristline can follow it: a call your phone would silence doesn\'t ring the watch either, and one it lets through (favourite contacts, repeat callers) still does. Change who gets through in your phone\'s Do Not Disturb settings.\n\n\"Not while I\'m using the phone\": when the phone is unlocked with the screen on, a call rings only the phone, not the watch.

On vivo also: Settings → Battery → Background power consumption → Wristline → Allow high background power consumption.
On Xiaomi also: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Wristline → turn on Autostart, and set Battery saver to No restrictions.
On Samsung also: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Wristline.
On OnePlus, OPPO and realme also: Settings → Battery → Wristline → allow background activity and auto-launch.

Three steps, about two minutes. Wristline ticks each one off by itself. You only need this once.
Missed it? Pull down your notifications, find Wristline\'s \"Enter the 6-digit pairing code\" and tap its small arrow: the \"Pair\" button is there.
Example of Wristline\'s notification with the pairing code typed in

All in one go, without coming back here:
1. Tap "Open Wireless debugging" below.
2. Tap the words "Wireless debugging" (not the switch).
3. Turn on "Use wireless debugging" and tap Allow.
4. Tap "Pair device with pairing code". A 6-digit code appears.
5. A Wristline message drops down from the top: tap "Pair", type the code and send it.
Don\'t switch back to Wristline to type the code: that closes the pairing screen and the code stops working.
